title: fix(plugin-auth)!: a cloud-managed environment refuses local self-registration, invitations (resends included), user creation and import, and sets passwords only on local accounts
body:
Fixes #25083

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What this does

This is the services half of the maintainer's ruling 6341690661 on #25083 (objectstack-ai/cloud#3132: hosted environments are managed; self-hosted is unaffected). On a cloud-managed environment, `isCloudManaged()` from `@objectstack/core` (#25306) narrows plugin-auth's local identity doors. With the variable unset, every door behaves exactly as on `main`.

| Door | Managed (`OS_CLOUD_MANAGED=1`) |
|:--|:--|
| Audience posture | Only `invite_only`, at construction and on every merged `applyConfigPatch` |
| Email sign-up | Both `disableSignUp` arms are forced on and advertised. The bootstrap owner's first sign-up still enters, as under SSO-only |
| `organization/invite-member` | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, refused at the route in the `before` hook, **resends included**. The `beforeCreateInvitation` arm stays as the second line |
| `admin/create-user`, `admin/import-users` | `409` after the admin check (a non-admin still hears `403`). Nothing is written |
| `admin/set-user-password` | Refuses an `idp_provisioned` target with `409`. An `env_native` target is still answered, so the break-glass admin stays editable |
| `set-initial-password` | Only a caller with platform-admin standing (`isPlatformAdminUser`). Another signed-in caller gets `409`; an anonymous caller still gets `401` |

The four raw routes answer the ADR-0112 envelope through `cloudManagedRefusal(door)`. `invite-member` answers better-auth's own `{ code, message }` body, as every org-hook refusal in this package does.

**For the cloud's twin** (objectstack-ai/cloud#3169, the per-environment `set-initial-password` the cloud mounts): the package entry now exports `cloudManagedRefusal`, `CLOUD_MANAGED_REFUSAL_CODE`, `CLOUD_MANAGED_REFUSAL_STATUS`, `CLOUD_MANAGED_REFUSAL_MESSAGES` and `CloudManagedDoor`. `isPlatformAdminUser` was already exported. That twin takes the same arm with the same refusal. This export is the widening in `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`; the door changes are the narrowing.

## Provenance

- The doors, the suite and the changeset were prepared by the `domain:services` seat 1 card thread (claim 6349623693) on `claude/project-thread-i0vfmz`, in commits `a6598847`, `7b0b758c` and `0366f01d`. They paused only because the core accessor and the spec flag had not landed.
- The maintainer then handed the card to the cloud ops seat (takeover claim 6359752007). This branch carries those commits, merges `main`, and adds the following:
  - the only merge conflict was in `auth-manager.ts`'s import block;
  - `hasPlatformAdminStanding` is no longer imported there, because it moved with the actor guards in #25273;
  - the suite calls `resetCloudManagedForTesting()` on every switch, because `isCloudManaged()` memoizes;
  - the package-entry export above;
  - the invite-member resend fix below.
- The served flag `features.cloudManaged` landed in #25309 and is not re-added here.

## Contract review (narrowing): PASS, with one should-fix fixed in this PR

The review was run at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` on head `5a3d27f6`. Its findings and dispositions:

1. **should-fix, fixed.** better-auth answers `invite-member { resend: true }` for a pending invitee before it consults `beforeCreateInvitation`. It extends `expiresAt` and re-sends the e-mail, and the console reaches that branch through `sys_invitation`'s `resend_invitation`. The `before` hook now refuses the route under the managed mode. Pinned by a resend leg (409, expiry unchanged) and its unmanaged control (200, expiry extended). Ablating the new arm reds only the resend leg.
2. **nit, kept.** `set-user-password` refuses `source === 'idp_provisioned'` and admits other values. A null `source` is answered as local, which matches the ruling's wording ("refuses `idp_provisioned` targets"). `sys_user.source` defaults to `env_native`.
3. **nit, fixed.** The changeset now names both body shapes instead of claiming `error.code` everywhere.
4. **nit, noted.** The JIT path is pinned through `decideAudienceAdmission` only. This diff does not touch that path.

## Verification (head `f37350ae`)

- `@objectstack/plugin-auth`:
  - test: Test Files 188 passed, Tests 3560 passed | 10 skipped;
  - typecheck (incl. `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0;
  - build: exit 0;
  - `src/cloud-managed.test.ts`: 32/32.
- Ablations: each was committed first, run under a trap restore, and restored to HEAD.

  | Ablation | Result |
  |:--|:--|
  | `set-initial-password` arm off | 1 failed |
  | memo reset removed | 5 failed |
  | package export removed | 1 failed |
  | invite-member route arm off | 1 failed |

- Full dogfood (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm), on the final head after building the `@objectstack/dogfood...` closure (66/66 tasks): Test Files 289 passed | 3 skipped, Tests 2491 passed | 18 skipped.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs` derived 135 commands from this diff; 129 can run locally. 120 exit 0. The other 9 are not measured here and are left to CI:
  - 4 need a PR context: `check-closing-target-claim`, `check-partof-closing-keyword`, `check-single-claim-paths`, `check-governed-queue-guard`. `check-partof-closing-keyword` was also run locally against this body; see below.
  - 2 need a whole-workspace build: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:published-readme-exports`.
  - 2 are `check-issue-citations` runs (plain and `--census`) whose board read was refused with HTTP 403. The plain run was measured green on the previous head, and this head adds no new issue citation.
  - 1 is `select-shard-timings-run --self-test`, which needs bash `mapfile`; macOS bash 3.2 lacks it.
- objectstack-ai/objectui#13330 (the console half) remains open and is being built separately. objectstack-ai/cloud#3169 remains open until this lands in the cloud's pin.
